about: Generated imagery for the My Dealer (mydealermn.com) redesign pitch, version 2, design 'Midnight Mesa' (glassmorphism with a mystical western look). Run: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/image-plan.json --key-file <path outside the project>. Every result is AI-generated and illustrative: never a picture of My Dealer's store, staff, customers or products. g- ids are editorial still lifes at night (weathered wood, brass, terracotta, turquoise stones, dried sage, warm lantern light, an indigo ground with star-like bokeh), subject right of centre with calm dark space on the left for hero text; g-smoke is kept from version 1. s- ids are wordless black-ink engravings with mirror symmetry and celestial accents (crescent moon, four-point stars, sun rays) on pure white; the three tall ones are generated at 3:4 and cropped to 4:5 after a paper clean-up (tmp/img/sketch-post.py), and templates multiply them onto parchment and recolour them to gold lines on night.

defaults.style: no people, no hands, no faces, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no brand marks, all surfaces blank and unmarked
